purpose: Literature-derived orthogonal candidate contracts; source/PIT feasibility only.

candidates.name: Patent semantic information state
candidates.hypothesis: Semantically informative patent text may contain incremental firm-value information beyond patent counts, citations and publication counts.
candidates.event_clock: official patent publication boundary; later prosecution/grant/citation updates excluded from historical prefix
candidates.construction_rule: Deterministic fixed construction first; no training on post-event documents; pretrained models require a training-corpus leakage audit.

candidates.name: Supply-chain disclosure sentiment propagation
candidates.hypothesis: Customer/supplier disclosure tone may contain focal-firm information not present in the focal firm's own tone, with slower transmission under low attention.
candidates.event_clock: official public-observation boundary; SEC route uses acceptance timestamp
candidates.construction_rule: Compare transcript-route source feasibility with a separate public SEC-text adaptation; do not inherit performance claims.

candidates.name: News-disagreement elasticity state
candidates.hypothesis: Volume-volatility elasticity around firm news may capture investor disagreement distinct from raw volume, raw volatility and ordinary sentiment.
candidates.construction_rule: Source-feasibility first; no performance until multi-year historical public intraday equity and news PIT contracts pass.
